resources.string: Private local prompt shortcuts, not scripts. Stored encrypted on this device, excluded from backups and settings exports. App updates keep Acts; uninstall or clearing app data deletes them. Pinned Acts appear first in the picker. Built-in examples are editable copies.

Use exactly one literal {input} placeholder. It is replaced once with selected text, or text before the cursor. The final prompt must fit 4000 characters. Definitions are instructions only: do not put credentials or URLs here. Send and Insert each require confirmation.
Permanently delete “%1$s” from this device? This cannot be undone.
No Acts. Add one in Acts settings.
Not saved. Use a unique name, exactly one {input}, and stay within the limits. URLs and recognizable credential assignments are forbidden. If valid, unlock the device and check storage availability.
Acts unavailable. Unlock the device and try again. Keystore or stored data could not be read; nothing was overwritten.
Select text or compose text before the cursor first. The expanded prompt must be 1–4000 characters; nothing is truncated or sent.
